name: Reading Time Estimator
tagline: Estimate how long it takes to read any text
description: Estimate reading time for any text based on average adult reading speed (200 WPM default, adjustable). Shows reading time in minutes, word count, and speaking time. Useful for blog posts, articles, and presentations.

inputs.name: text
inputs.label: Text
inputs.placeholder: Paste your article or text here...

expert_defs.name: reading_time_estimate
expert_defs.description: Estimates reading and speaking time for a text. Params: text (input text), wpm (reading speed, default 200). Returns JSON with output_type json containing reading_time_min, speaking_time_min, word_count.
